title: Check display settings
body: The researcher can check the display or continue with the current settings. Continuing is possible in either fullscreen or windowed mode.
setup: Use 1920 × 1080 pixels, 100% display scaling and browser zoom, and fullscreen on the intended display. Ctrl + 0 resets browser zoom.
ready: The display matches the intended settings again. The researcher can confirm that you may continue.
waiting: The intended display settings could not yet be confirmed.
fullscreen_failed: Fullscreen could not be opened. Please use the browser's fullscreen option.
timers: Any running time limits still apply.
calibration_interrupted: The display changed during calibration. Please repeat calibration.
continue_unverified_notice: Continuing with the current display preserves answers and time limits. Unverified gaze data will not be used for AOI analysis. This permission lasts until the page is reloaded or you sign out.

reasons.checking_display: The display must remain stable briefly before it can be confirmed.
reasons.screen_resolution: The reported screen resolution does not match 1920 × 1080 pixels.
reasons.window_size: The reported browser area does not match 1920 × 1080 pixels.
reasons.window_position: The browser reports a different window position.
reasons.display_scale: The reported display scaling or browser zoom does not match 100%.
reasons.viewport_zoom: The visible page area is zoomed or shifted.
reasons.window_focus: The study window is not in the foreground.
reasons.native_measurement: The Windows bridge must confirm the current study page position.

native_setup: The Windows bridge measures the study page’s position on the display directly. Fullscreen and windowed mode are supported. Keep the study page in the foreground on the eye tracker’s display.
native_ready: The study page’s position has been measured. The researcher can confirm gaze mapping. Later window-size changes will be measured automatically.
mapping_waiting: AOI mapping is waiting for a valid display measurement.

connection.idle: The Windows bridge has not been checked yet.
connection.permission_pending: Please confirm local network access in Edge.
connection.connected: Windows bridge connected. Checking the display measurement.
connection.unreachable: The Windows bridge on this PC cannot be reached.
connection.upgrade_required: The connected Windows bridge does not yet support windowed measurements.

connection_setup: Verified gaze data in fullscreen and windowed mode requires the current Windows bridge on this PC. Keep the study page in the foreground on the calibrated display.
connection_help: Start the current Windows bridge on this PC and leave it running. Click “Reconnect bridge” and allow access to the local network if Edge asks.
permission_denied: Edge is blocking access to the local bridge. Open site permissions using the icon to the left of the address and set “Apps on device” or “Loopback network” to “Allow”. Older Edge versions call this permission “Local network”. Then click “Reconnect bridge”.

copied.failed: Automatic copying is unavailable. Please select and copy the diagnostic text.

recovery.upgrade: Download and extract the current Windows bridge. Fully close the old bridge, start the new version, and click “Reconnect bridge”. The previous fullscreen check remains available.
recovery.focus: Bring this study window to the foreground and close any open browser dialogs. Keep the window unchanged briefly.
recovery.displays: Use only the eye tracker’s calibrated display. Disconnect or disable additional displays in Windows display settings, then bring the study page back to the foreground.
recovery.geometry: The browser content area could not be measured unambiguously. Close docked developer tools and browser sidebars, keep the entire study window on the calibrated display, and click “Reconnect bridge”. Fullscreen is not required with the current bridge.
recovery.zoom: Reset page zoom with Ctrl + 0 and finish any ongoing zoom or pan gesture. Then keep the window unchanged briefly.
recovery.platform: This display measurement requires Windows, Edge, and the current Windows bridge. Start the current bridge on the study PC and reconnect it.
recovery.tabs: Another study page is holding the display measurement. Use only one study tab for this session. Close additional study tabs and reconnect the bridge.
recovery.stale: The display measurement is not current yet. Keep this window unchanged in the foreground briefly. If the message persists, reconnect the bridge.

check.title: Check display settings
check.notice: Gaze is currently not being assigned to areas.

summary.ok: The display matches the intended settings.
summary.warn: Some settings differ from the intended setup. Pages may wrap or scroll differently.
summary.fail: The settings below differ or could not yet be checked. The study can still continue.
summary.pending: The settings below could not yet be confirmed. The study can still continue.

row.resolution: Screen resolution (as reported by the browser)
row.browser_area: Browser area of the study page
row.zoom_gesture: Page enlarged or moved by a gesture

check.note_native: The current Windows bridge measures the position of the study page itself. Resolution, scaling and full screen then only affect the page layout, not the assignment.
check.note_legacy: Without the current Windows bridge, gaze can only be assigned at 1920 × 1080 pixels, 100% scaling and zoom, and in full screen (F11). On 15.6-inch devices Windows scaling is often set to 125%: Windows Settings → System → Display → Scale → 100%. Reset browser zoom: Ctrl + 0.
check.note_unverified: This display does not stop the study. Deviations are logged.
check.notice_focus: Gaze is currently not being assigned to areas. Please click once on the study page.

disclosure.fail: Not all settings match — show details.
disclosure.pending: Some settings still need checking — show details.

calibration_unverified: The display is not verified yet. Please check the display settings and start the calibration again.
